_published_faq.name: How do I add Cottages to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cottages to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cottages.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Cottages MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Cottages scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cottages MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cottages provides these MCP tools: search-cottages and send_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cottages?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cottages in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Cottages does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
